title: Desenvolvedor(a) Mobile Android Sênior – Kotlin Multiplatform
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Mobile Android Sênior para atuar em um projeto temporário (contrato de 3 a 4 meses) , com foco em Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), arquiteturas modernas de apps móveis e integração com GraphQL.

Você será responsável por evoluir nossos aplicativos Android e contribuir na estrutura multiplataforma, garantindo alta performance, estabilidade e experiência de uso consistente.

Procuramos alguém com sólido domínio técnico, mentalidade de produto, e visão arquitetural, capaz de entregar soluções escaláveis e manuteníveis em um ambiente colaborativo e ágil.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações mobile Android com Kotlin e Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) , compartilhando código entre plataformas quando aplicável.
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas escaláveis e reativas (Clean Architecture, MVVM, MVI).
  • Integrar com APIs GraphQL de forma eficiente e segura.
  • Assegurar performance, estabilidade e responsividade das aplicações.
  • Escrever código limpo, modular e testável , com atenção à manutenibilidade e boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Garantir qualidade de software com testes automatizados (unitários, instrumentados e end-to-end).
  • Participar ativamente de discussões de arquitetura , code reviews e decisões técnicas .
  • Colaborar com designers, product managers e engenheiros backend para construir experiências consistentes e de alto impacto.


Essenciais (ênfase da vaga):

  • Experiência sólida com Kotlin e desenvolvimento Android nativo (Jetpack, Compose, Coroutines, Flow).
  • Vivência prática em Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) e Ktor para compartilhamento de código entre plataformas.
  • Domínio de arquiteturas modernas (MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture).
  • Integração com APIs GraphQL .
  • Cultura de testes automatizados (JUnit, Espresso, Kaspresso, MockK).
  • Conhecimento sólido em injeção de dependência (Hilt, Koin).


Importantes (secundários, mas valorizados):

  • Conhecimento em Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile (KMM) com integração iOS.
  • Experiência em consumo offline-first (Room, SQLDelight, caching).
  • Vivência com Compose Multiplatform .
  • Conhecimento em design system e componentização cross-platform .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em aplicações de grande escala e alto tráfego .
  • Participação em times ágeis com forte cultura de engenharia e DevOps.


Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.


Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

Caso haja alguma dúvida relacionada à proteção de dados ou qualquer aspecto envolvendo o tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal:

description:
Work at Exadel - Who We Are:

Since 1998, Exadel has been engineering its products and custom software for clients of all sizes. Headquartered in Walnut Creek, California, Exadel has 2,800+ employees in development centers across America, Europe, and Asia. People drive Exadel’s success and are at the core of our values.



*Responsibilities*

Design and implement prioritized backend features using best software engineering practices and consistent functional and technical validations throughout the development lifecycle.

Deliver scalable, flexible, and resilient solutions aligned with modern architectural principles.

Apply and advocate for architectural patterns such as event-driven microservices.

Actively participate in technical discussions and contribute to the evolution of the product’s technical architecture.

Support product discussions by providing technical input to guide architecture-related decisions.

Integrate internal and external services using RESTful APIs, asynchronous messaging, and event hubs.

  • Experience in backend development with Java 8+
  • Experience with Spring Boot
  • Strong experience in developing and deploying microservices in public cloud environments (preferably AWS).
  • Solid knowledge of relational (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and non-relational databases (e.g., DynamoDB, MongoDB).

title: Consultor Sênior Bloomreach Experience Manager
description:
Visão Geral da Função:

Estamos buscando um Consultor Sênior altamente qualificado e experiente em Bloomreach Experience Manager (brXM) para integrar nossa equipe. Este papel é fundamental para ajudar nossos clientes a projetar, implementar e otimizar suas experiências digitais utilizando a plataforma Bloomreach. O candidato ideal terá profundo conhecimento técnico em brXM e forte compreensão de estratégias de experiência digital. Você atuará como consultor técnico, liderando projetos desde a descoberta até a implantação bem-sucedida, garantindo que nossos clientes obtenham o máximo valor de seu investimento.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Liderança Técnica & Arquitetura:

Liderar o design técnico e arquitetura das soluções Bloomreach Experience Manager, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos de negócio e requisitos técnicos dos clientes.

Fornecer orientação especializada sobre melhores práticas para modelagem de conteúdo, desenvolvimento de componentes e gerenciamento de ativos digitais na plataforma brXM.

Conduzir sessões técnicas de descoberta e workshops com clientes e equipes internas para definir os requisitos da solução.

Diagnosticar e resolver questões técnicas complexas relacionadas às implementações de brXM.


Desenvolvimento & Implementação:

Supervisionar a entrega técnica completa dos projetos brXM, incluindo desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.

Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento multifuncionais para garantir a execução fluida dos projetos.

Garantir que as entregas técnicas atendam a altos padrões de qualidade e sejam entregues no prazo.


Mentoria & Compartilhamento de Conhecimento:

Orientar desenvolvedores juniores sobre as melhores práticas e novas funcionalidades do Bloomreach.

Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de metodologias internas, ferramentas e melhores práticas para implementações brXM.

Manter-se atualizado com as últimas tendências e atualizações no espaço de plataformas de experiência digital (DXP) e no roadmap de produtos Bloomreach.


Requisitos Técnicos:

Mais de 5 anos de experiência com plataformas CMS ou DXP de nível empresarial, sendo pelo menos 3 anos focados especificamente no Bloomreach Experience Manager (brXM).

Expertise profunda em desenvolvimento Java e no Spring Framework, incluindo Spring MVC, Spring Boot e Spring Security.

Experiência comprovada com os principais recursos do brXM, como o modelo Headless State (HST), Content as a Service (CaaS) e modelagem avançada de conteúdo.

Forte entendimento da arquitetura baseada em componentes do brXM e experiência no desenvolvimento de componentes personalizados, templates e plugins.

Conhecimento extensivo das APIs nativas do brXM para gerenciamento de conteúdo, usuários e personalização.

Especialização na integração do brXM com sistemas terceiros, como CRMs, PIMs, plataformas de e-commerce (ex: Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Hybris) e ferramentas de automação de marketing.

Proficiência em tecnologias modernas de front-end (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+) e experiência com frameworks populares como React, Angular ou Vue.js para construção de aplicações desacopladas ou headless.

Experiência com ferramentas de build e gerenciamento de dependências (ex: Maven, Gradle) e sistemas de controle de versão (ex: Git).

Familiaridade com práticas e ferramentas DevOps, incluindo pipelines CI/CD, containerização (Docker, Kubernetes) e infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Experiência em tuning de performance e otimização de aplicações brXM, incluindo estratégias de cache e otimização de banco de dados.

Compreensão de tecnologias de busca e sua integração com brXM, especialmente Bloomreach Search ou Apache Solr/Elasticsearch.

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou área relacionada, ou experiência prática equivalente.


Qualificações Preferenciais:

Certificação Bloomreach Developer ou Architect.

Experiência com outros componentes da suíte Bloomreach (ex: Bloomreach Search & Merchandising, Bloomreach Engagement).

Experiência em ambiente de desenvolvimento Agile/Scrum.

Conduzir sessões técnicas de descoberta e workshops com clientes e equipes internas para definir os requisitos da solução.

Diagnosticar e resolver questões técnicas complexas relacionadas às implementações de brXM.


Desenvolvimento & Implementação:

Supervisionar a entrega técnica completa dos projetos brXM, incluindo desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.

Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento multifuncionais para garantir a execução fluida dos projetos.

Garantir que as entregas técnicas atendam a altos padrões de qualidade e sejam entregues no prazo.


Mentoria & Compartilhamento de Conhecimento:

Orientar desenvolvedores juniores sobre as melhores práticas e novas funcionalidades do Bloomreach.

Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de metodologias internas, ferramentas e melhores práticas para implementações brXM.

Manter-se atualizado com as últimas tendências e atualizações no espaço de plataformas de experiência digital (DXP) e no roadmap de produtos Bloomreach.


Requisitos Técnicos:

Mais de 5 anos de experiência com plataformas CMS ou DXP de nível empresarial, sendo pelo menos 3 anos focados especificamente no Bloomreach Experience Manager (brXM).

Expertise profunda em desenvolvimento Java e no Spring Framework, incluindo Spring MVC, Spring Boot e Spring Security.

Experiência comprovada com os principais recursos do brXM, como o modelo Headless State (HST), Content as a Service (CaaS) e modelagem avançada de conteúdo.

Forte entendimento da arquitetura baseada em componentes do brXM e experiência no desenvolvimento de componentes personalizados, templates e plugins.

Conhecimento extensivo das APIs nativas do brXM para gerenciamento de conteúdo, usuários e personalização.

Especialização na integração do brXM com sistemas terceiros, como CRMs, PIMs, plataformas de e-commerce (ex: Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Hybris) e ferramentas de automação de marketing.

Proficiência em tecnologias modernas de front-end (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+) e experiência com frameworks populares como React, Angular ou Vue.js para construção de aplicações desacopladas ou headless.

Experiência com ferramentas de build e gerenciamento de dependências (ex: Maven, Gradle) e sistemas de controle de versão (ex: Git).

Familiaridade com práticas e ferramentas DevOps, incluindo pipelines CI/CD, containerização (Docker, Kubernetes) e infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Experiência em tuning de performance e otimização de aplicações brXM, incluindo estratégias de cache e otimização de banco de dados.

Compreensão de tecnologias de busca e sua integração com brXM, especialmente Bloomreach Search ou Apache Solr/Elasticsearch.

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou área relacionada, ou experiência prática equivalente.


Qualificações Preferenciais:

Certificação Bloomreach Developer ou Architect.

Experiência com outros componentes da suíte Bloomreach (ex: Bloomreach Search & Merchandising, Bloomreach Engagement).

Experiência em ambiente de desenvolvimento Agile/Scrum.

title: Desenvolvedor de front-end - Shopify
description:
Buscamos um desenvolvedor Shopify. A posição é remota e o fuso horário deve estar alinhado com o de Pittsburgh (EUA) .


Responsabilidades:

1. Reescrita do Storefront em Hydrogen

  • Reconstruir e aprimorar a vitrine Shopify existente da Industrial Powder usando Hydrogen 2.0 e a Shopify Storefront GraphQL API .
  • Replicar e melhorar o conjunto de recursos atual:
  • Páginas de detalhes de produtos
  • Diferenciação entre produtos sob encomenda, em estoque, painéis, tambores e pequenos lotes
  • Coleções com filtragem
  • Lógica de preços específica para B2B
  • Descontos, comportamento do carrinho e integração de checkout
  • Gerenciamento de contas de clientes
  • Pesquisa, navegação e acessibilidade
  • Layout responsivo com foco em dispositivos móveis


2. Biblioteca de Componentes Reutilizáveis

  • Criar uma biblioteca de componentes de interface (UI) baseada em React , seguindo o sistema de design PPG Primer :
  • Reconstruir componentes principais (botões, cabeçalhos, banners, modais, tabelas etc.) para React, usando os tokens de design existentes (atualmente uma biblioteca de componentes em .NET)
  • Garantir acessibilidade, responsividade e personalização
  • Fornecer documentação e exemplos ao vivo usando o Storybook
  • Entregar como um submódulo Git ou pacote privado NPM


3. Framework de Configuração de Lançamento Rápido

  • Entregar um modelo inicial (Starter Template) em Hydrogen para futuras vitrines:
  • Modelos de configuração de ambiente
  • Suporte para substituição de temas conforme a marca de cada região
  • Roteamento, localização e configuração de CI/CD pré-configurados
  • Estrutura de pastas escalável e alternância entre regiões


4. Integração com o CMS Kontent.ai

  • Integrar o Kontent.ai como CMS para todo o conteúdo não relacionado a produtos:
  • Utilizar as APIs GraphQL ou REST do Kontent.ai para entregar conteúdo aos componentes Hydrogen
  • Implementar blocos de conteúdo modulares gerenciados pelo CMS (Hero, Banner Promocional, Depoimentos, FAQs etc.)
  • Habilitar layouts de página dinâmicos e páginas de marketing (ex.: /sobre-nos, /sustentabilidade)
  • Integração no nível de rotas: permitir que o CMS controle navegação e estrutura de layout
  • Suporte a campos de conteúdo localizados para vitrines multilíngues e multi-regiões
  • Implementar funcionalidade de pré-visualização segura para revisar atualizações de conteúdo em ambiente de testes
  • Colaborar com os responsáveis pelo conteúdo para definir e implementar modelos e fluxos de trabalho dentro do Kontent.ai

title: Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores
description:
Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores | EQI Investimentos


Você sonha em construir uma carreira sólida no mercado financeiro, transformar a vida das pessoas por meio dos investimentos e ter a chance de ser contratado pela empresa que mais cresce no mercado financeiro?

Aqui na EQI estamos com vagas abertas para o Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores.

title: Project Integration Specialist - Brazil
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Project Integration Specialist - Brazil , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

The Project Integration Specialist is responsible for overseeing the integration and coordination of various IT projects within the organization, ensuring that all components of the projects are aligned, executed efficiently, and meet the company's strategic objectives. This professional acts as a technical leader, advisor and mentor, ensuring the cohesion and success of integration projects.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Leadership and Technical Consulting: Acting as a technical lead to ensure that project implementations are aligned with architectural design, guiding cross-functional teams, and fostering communication and collaboration among all stakeholders.
  • End-to-End Solution Design: Develop and implement comprehensive integration plans for IT projects. Assess the compatibility and interoperability of different systems and technologies through thorough testing and evaluation.
  • Project and Resource Management: Plan and manage the timelines and deliverables of integration projects. Allocate and manage resources effectively, including budgeting and staffing. Monitor project progress and performance, ensuring adherence to timelines and budget.
  • Technology Selection and Validation: Conduct technical assessments and feasibility studies for new integration projects to determine the best approach and resources needed. Stay up-to-date on emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Risk Management: Identify and resolve integration issues and technical challenges through troubleshooting and collaboration with technical teams. Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies to ensure projects stay on track.
  • Governance and Compliance: Ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices throughout the integration process.
  • Documentation and Continuous Improvement: Prepare and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including integration plans, status reports, and risk assessments. Drive continuous improvement in integration processes and methodologies by analyzing project results and implementing feedback.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT project management , integration, or related field.
  • Systems Integration: Experience with a variety of integration tools and platforms (e.g., middleware, APIs) to facilitate the integration of projects, configuring and maintaining them. Experience in designing integrations between data systems and other enterprise platforms (e.g., ERPs such as SAP, CRMs).
  • Architecture: Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, and software development. Experience with software architecture design, including microservices, SOA (Service-Oriented Architecture), and cloud-based architectures.
  • Systems and Tools: Use of integration tools and platforms. Implementation and management of systems to track and report metrics of integration projects, including the configuration of dashboards and monitoring tools.

Languages: Advanced English and/or French.


Soft Skills:

  • Communication and Influence: Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts to varied audiences (technical, executive, business). Build strong relationships with stakeholders to ensure their needs are met and foster a collaborative environment.
  • Leadership and Collaboration: Ability to lead by example, working with cross-functional teams and building consensus among stakeholders.
  • Strategic Vision: Ability to think "in the big picture", aligning technological decisions with the company's long-term objectives.
  • Problem Solving: Proactive and analytical profile, engaged in identifying and solving complex challenges.

Organization and Focus: Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and results-focused environment.


Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Education: Master's degree in a related field.
  • Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) or other relevant certifications. Certifications in cloud architecture (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Solutions Architect).
  • Technologies: Experience with cloud computing and data integration. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Expected Skills:

  • Ensure that the needs of the business are aligned with the architectural vision.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
  • Ensure scalability/performance, security, and quality standards.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement in development processes and existing architecture.
  • Analyze the technological environment and seek possibilities for improvement and standardization in line with strategic planning.
  • Present to stakeholders how the architecture options will meet their needs.

title: Public Relations Manager - LATAM
description:
About Cooler Master

Cooler Master is a global computer hardware manufacturer founded in 1992 in Taiwan. The company is known for its award-winning PC components, including cases, power supplies, cooling solutions, and accessories.


In addition to retail product lines, Cooler Master also serves as an OEM partner to major technology brands worldwide. The company has grown steadily through a strong focus on innovation, design, and user-driven product development. Headquartered in Taipei, Cooler Master operates manufacturing facilities in China and maintains regional offices across the globe.


Role Overview

Lead public relations for Latin America (LATAM) to elevate Cooler Master’s visibility across key markets such as Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, and Chile.

You’ll manage PR execution for launches and ongoing brand activations—aligning local media, translating technical information into engaging stories, and ensuring consistent communication with global and regional marketing teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the LATAM PR Plan – Develop and execute the regional PR calendar and embargo plan; ensure alignment with global launches and LATAM sales priorities.
  • Build Media Relationships – Cultivate strong connections with top-tier tech and gaming editors, reviewers, and influencers across Portuguese and Spanish-speaking markets.
  • Host Press Briefings & Events – Lead virtual and local events; manage press lists, invitations, materials, and post-event follow-ups.
  • Coordinate Product Reviews – Manage the sample allocation, delivery, and follow-up process with regional media outlets.
  • Partner Collaboration – Drive joint PR opportunities with distributors, e-commerce partners, and brand collaborators.
  • Content Localization – Adapt global press materials for LATAM audiences to ensure cultural and linguistic accuracy.
  • Monitor & Report – Track press coverage, analyze media performance metrics, and deliver post-launch summaries.
  • Maintain Compliance – Ensure consistent application of embargoes, NDA terms, and authorized content usage.


Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field.
  • Experience : 5–8+ years in tech, consumer electronics, or gaming PR across LATAM. Proven track record in media relations and launch management.
  • Regional Expertise :
  • Strong understanding of LATAM media ecosystem and regional communication styles.
  • Existing relationships with major tech and gaming outlets.
  • Language Skills :
  • Fluent in English and either Portuguese or Spanish (bilingual proficiency preferred).
  • Execution & Measurement :
  • Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple launches.
  • Familiarity with PR metrics such as share of voice and media reach.


Who You Are

  • A proactive communicator with high accountability and attention to detail.
  • Skilled at relationship-building across diverse markets and cultures.
  • Confident managing embargoes, timelines, and media expectations.
  • Adaptable and independent, yet collaborative with global teammates.

title: Scrum Master - Remoto (Vaga Afirmativa PCD)
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:


Scrum Master - Remoto (Vaga Afirmativa PCD)


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação como Facilitador no desenvolvimento da solução de TI e evolução de produtos de TI, baseando-se no Manifesto Ágil para buscar a eficiência do time e entrega de valor a um cliente do ramo bancário.


• Sugerir e acompanhar metodologias para aferição de métricas de processo, atuando para promover as melhorias contínuas necessárias ao time/equipe;

• Apoiar os desenvolvedores no aprimoramento de suas necessidades técnicas durante o desenvolvimento da solução de TI;

• Apoiar o Gestor de Valor na priorização dos itens de Backlog;

• Auxiliar o Gestor de Valor na descrição dos itens de Backlog, até o ponto em que estes estejam com detalhamento suficiente para atuação;

• Apoiar o time/equipe na construção das métricas de negócio necessárias para o acompanhamento do retorno de valor ao cliente, em conjunto com os demais membros do time/equipe;

• Apurar as métricas de negócio, em conjunto com os demais membros do time/equipe;

• Avaliar, propor e induzir as mudanças no processo de trabalho do time/equipe para evolução do nível de maturidade;

• Apoiar na Interação com outros times/equipes, durante o desenvolvimento da solução de TI, para retirar impedimentos, dependências e sombreamentos, com foco no maior retorno de valor para a empresa/cliente.


O que esperamos de você:

• Desejável conhecimento prévio de ferramentas como genTI (IBM Jazz no mercado) e BusinessMap (Kanbanize no mercado).

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Engenheiro de Software II
description:
Buscamos um Engenheiro(a) de Software II para atuar no desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções corporativas do ecossistema Backoffice — abrangendo áreas como Financeiro, Fiscal, Contábil, Controladoria, Comercial e Cadastro.

O profissional será responsável por garantir a qualidade técnica das entregas, aplicar boas práticas de engenharia de software e contribuir com a evolução arquitetural das aplicações, com foco em performance, escalabilidade e integração entre sistemas.


Responsabilidades principais

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend e integrações entre sistemas corporativos.
  • Aplicar princípios de Clean Code, SOLID e Design Patterns.
  • Implementar testes automatizados e participar de code reviews.
  • Colaborar na definição de soluções arquiteturais e otimização de rotinas críticas.
  • Garantir observabilidade e estabilidade das aplicações.
  • Colaborar com POs e analistas de negócio na definição técnica de requisitos e regras de negócio.


Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência com Python, PHP (Laravel) ou Node.js.
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Aurora).
  • Vivência com integrações REST/SOAP, mensageria (SQS, SNS, RabbitMQ, Kafka) e ambientes cloud (AWS ou similares).
  • Experiência com Git e práticas CI/CD / DevOps.


Diferenciais

  • Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Serverless Framework.
  • Conhecimento em SAP B1 SDK, Tax One, IDT ou sistemas fiscais/financeiros.
  • Experiência com monitoramento (Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog).
  • Métodos ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).


Perfil desejado

  • Protagonismo técnico e senso de dono.
  • Comunicação colaborativa e foco em soluções.
  • Organização e aprendizado contínuo.


Formação: Superior completo em TI ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação e certificações técnicas são diferenciais.



Informações adicionais

Na Total Express a diversidade é um compromisso com todos os nossos colaboradores, parceiros e clientes com o objetivo de eliminar barreiras, desconstruir estereótipos, promover a igualdade de oportunidades e celebrar a riqueza de nossas diferenças. Queremos criar um ambiente onde todos se sintam confortáveis em serem autênticos e onde a diversidade seja cultivada e respeitada em todos os níveis.


O movimento faz parte da nossa identidade. E aqui na Total estamos sempre em busca de novas formas de valorizar e apoiar o crescimento dos nossos colaboradores. Conheça os benefícios que oferecemos


• Vale Refeição.

• Day off de aniversário no mês do seu aniversário.

• Plano de saúde com custo zero para o colaborador na taxa administrativa mensal, descontando apenas a coparticipação.

Buscamos um Engenheiro(a) de Software II para atuar no desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções corporativas do ecossistema Backoffice — abrangendo áreas como Financeiro, Fiscal, Contábil, Controladoria, Comercial e Cadastro.

O profissional será responsável por garantir a qualidade técnica das entregas, aplicar boas práticas de engenharia de software e contribuir com a evolução arquitetural das aplicações, com foco em performance, escalabilidade e integração entre sistemas.


Responsabilidades principais

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend e integrações entre sistemas corporativos.
  • Aplicar princípios de Clean Code, SOLID e Design Patterns.
  • Implementar testes automatizados e participar de code reviews.
  • Colaborar na definição de soluções arquiteturais e otimização de rotinas críticas.
  • Garantir observabilidade e estabilidade das aplicações.
  • Colaborar com POs e analistas de negócio na definição técnica de requisitos e regras de negócio.


Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência com Python, PHP (Laravel) ou Node.js.
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Aurora).
  • Vivência com integrações REST/SOAP, mensageria (SQS, SNS, RabbitMQ, Kafka) e ambientes cloud (AWS ou similares).
  • Experiência com Git e práticas CI/CD / DevOps.


Diferenciais

  • Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Serverless Framework.
  • Conhecimento em SAP B1 SDK, Tax One, IDT ou sistemas fiscais/financeiros.
  • Experiência com monitoramento (Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog).
  • Métodos ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).


Perfil desejado

  • Protagonismo técnico e senso de dono.
  • Comunicação colaborativa e foco em soluções.
  • Organização e aprendizado contínuo.


Formação: Superior completo em TI ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação e certificações técnicas são diferenciais.



Informações adicionais

Na Total Express a diversidade é um compromisso com todos os nossos colaboradores, parceiros e clientes com o objetivo de eliminar barreiras, desconstruir estereótipos, promover a igualdade de oportunidades e celebrar a riqueza de nossas diferenças. Queremos criar um ambiente onde todos se sintam confortáveis em serem autênticos e onde a diversidade seja cultivada e respeitada em todos os níveis.


O movimento faz parte da nossa identidade. E aqui na Total estamos sempre em busca de novas formas de valorizar e apoiar o crescimento dos nossos colaboradores. Conheça os benefícios que oferecemos

title: Analista  Ambiental Sr.
description:
Você é uma pessoa prática, comprometida e com conhecimento técnico na área ambiental?

Temos uma excelente oportunidade para você!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Ambiental Sênior para atuar diretamente no chão de fábrica, sendo a referência técnica e operacional em temas ambientais.

Esse profissional será responsável por acompanhar e executar ações que assegurem a conformidade legal e fortaleçam a cultura de sustentabilidade nos processos produtivos.


Requisitos desejáveis:


Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Ambiental, Biologia, Gestão Ambiental ou áreas correlatas;

Cursos complementares em Resíduos Sólidos, Legislação Ambiental e Segurança do Trabalho serão diferenciais;

Vivência prévia em ambiente industrial/fabril;

Atuação prática com controle de resíduos, coleta seletiva e rotinas ambientais operacionais;

Conhecimento em licenciamento ambiental e controle documental;

Desejável experiência com auditorias e fiscalizações ambientais.


Responsabilidades:


Executar e acompanhar todas as etapas da cadeia de gestão ambiental da empresa;

Garantir o cumprimento dos procedimentos de descarte e destinação de resíduos, atuando em conjunto com a equipe operacional;

Apoiar e representar a empresa durante fiscalizações e auditorias ambientais;

Implementar e monitorar práticas sustentáveis e tecnologias de otimização de recursos;

Promover treinamentos e ações de conscientização ambiental;

Indicadores de Desempenho Ambiental (KPIs).

Controle de Manifesto de Resíduos (MTR).

Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas da empresa, assegurando o equilíbrio entre sustentabilidade e eficiência operacional.


Benefícios:

Vale refeição

Vale Alimentação

Vale transporte

TotalPass


Se você busca fazer a diferença e contribuir para um futuro mais sustentável, essa oportunidade é para você!

Envie seu currículo para:

Colocando no assunto: Analista Ambiental Sr.


Boa Sorte!

title: JD Edwards (Financial Consultant)
description:
Business Analyst (Financial)


**Add resumes in English**


• Ensure JDE, Trintech, and other financial applications are compliant with Gallagher’s IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.

• Evaluate SOC reports to ensure vendor and application compliance and surface risks.

Skills

Required:

• Relevant experience working with Financial ERP applications, preferably JDE

• Design and Development Experience with JDE

• Experience working with third party vendors to implement SaaS solutions

• Working "hands-on" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of key accounting, financial management and analysis processes, including but not limited to General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, revenue recognition, budgeting, and bank interfaces

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel and Project


Requirements:

Building a trading platform for innovative international top-tier hedge fund from the ground up, comprising of front-office system for traders, pre-trade checks and analysis, intra-day positions management, order management and routing, risks and limits management, reports of trading activities, FIX connectivity, market data providers connectivity (e.g. Bloomberg B-pipe).

  • Monitor and tune performance of large-scale time-series datasets for latency and throughput.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, ensuring high data quality, reliability, and uptime.
  • Partner with quantitative researchers and traders to design new data-driven features and analytics.



Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-8 years of hands-on experience developing in KDB+/q within a trading or financial environment.
  • Strong understanding of time-series data, market data structures, and real-time data processing.
  • Solid working knowledge of Linux and scripting for system monitoring and automation.
  • Proficiency in query optimization, data modeling, and performance tuning in KDB.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with engineering, quant, and trading teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and reliability.

title: Sales representative
description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline

  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion

  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach

  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions

  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

    • QUALIFICATIONS

    • 1+ years of commission sales experience

    • Strong

    • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation

    • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable

    • Strong problem-solving skills

    • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.

    • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability

    • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

    • WHAT WE OFFER

    • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses

    • Remote-friendly work environment

    • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development

    • Supportive, high-performing team culture

title: Lead Engineer – Agentic AI
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Lead Engineer – Agentic AI , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

You’ll lead the architecture, development, and deployment of next-generation agentic AI systems that transform enterprise operations. These intelligent agents will autonomously orchestrate workflows, analyze real-time data, and embed decision-making across domains like finance, sales, and operations. You’ll guide cross-functional teams, mentor engineers, and ensure technical excellence across all stages of delivery. Microsoft AI Foundry will be a key platform for agent development, and Copilot Studio may be used optionally for few use cases.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and lead development of scalable, production-grade agentic AI systems.
  • Design serverless, event-driven workflows using Azure Functions , Logic Apps , and Power Automate .
  • Build and optimize ML models for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and recommendations using Azure ML , Databricks , and Python .
  • Integrate agents with enterprise platforms such as SAP HANA , Salesforce , Snowflake , Kafka , and UiPath .
  • Ensure observability and reliability through Azure Monitor , logging, and alerting frameworks.
  • Define and enforce architecture patterns, reusable components, and governance standards.
  • Lead code reviews, technical design sessions, and agile ceremonies.
  • Leverage Microsoft AI Foundry to build and deploy agents that meet enterprise-grade standards.


Leadership Responsibilities

  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
  • Drive cross-team collaboration and alignment on agentic AI strategy and execution.
  • Own delivery timelines, quality benchmarks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Champion best practices in DevOps, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management.
  • Stay ahead of trends in AI, machine vision, and IoT to guide strategic decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Data Scientists & ML Engineers – for model development and integration
  • Product Managers & UX Designers – aligning agent capabilities with user needs
  • Enterprise Architects & DevOps Engineers – ensuring scalability and deployment efficiency
  • Security & Compliance Teams – meeting regulatory and governance requirements
  • Business Stakeholders & SMEs – defining use cases and validating outcomes
  • Change Management & Enablement Teams – supporting adoption and training efforts

Technology & Tools

  • Languages & Platforms : Python, Power Apps, Power Automate, Databricks, Snowflake
  • Enterprise Systems : SAP HANA, Kafka, UiPath

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Pleno
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;


Requisitos e qualificações

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;


Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.
  • Fazemos Code Review. Nenhuma mudança vai para a operação sem o time aprovar. Seja via thumbs up do Gitlab ou durante uma discussão da daily.
  • Todo desenvolvimento de uma nova fonte é baseado em especificações que são escritas pela nossa pessoa Data Owner. Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
company: TD Media LLC (dba Life Water Media)

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Lead Engineer – Agentic AI , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

You’ll lead the architecture, development, and deployment of next-generation agentic AI systems that transform enterprise operations. These intelligent agents will autonomously orchestrate workflows, analyze real-time data, and embed decision-making across domains like finance, sales, and operations. You’ll guide cross-functional teams, mentor engineers, and ensure technical excellence across all stages of delivery. Microsoft AI Foundry will be a key platform for agent development, and Copilot Studio may be used optionally for few use cases.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and lead development of scalable, production-grade agentic AI systems.
  • Design serverless, event-driven workflows using Azure Functions , Logic Apps , and Power Automate .
  • Build and optimize ML models for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and recommendations using Azure ML , Databricks , and Python .
  • Integrate agents with enterprise platforms such as SAP HANA , Salesforce , Snowflake , Kafka , and UiPath .
  • Ensure observability and reliability through Azure Monitor , logging, and alerting frameworks.
  • Define and enforce architecture patterns, reusable components, and governance standards.
  • Lead code reviews, technical design sessions, and agile ceremonies.
  • Leverage Microsoft AI Foundry to build and deploy agents that meet enterprise-grade standards.


Leadership Responsibilities

  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
  • Drive cross-team collaboration and alignment on agentic AI strategy and execution.
  • Own delivery timelines, quality benchmarks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Champion best practices in DevOps, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management.
  • Stay ahead of trends in AI, machine vision, and IoT to guide strategic decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Data Scientists & ML Engineers – for model development and integration

  • Enterprise Architects & DevOps Engineers – ensuring scalability and deployment efficiency
  • Security & Compliance Teams – meeting regulatory and governance requirements
  • Business Stakeholders & SMEs – defining use cases and validating outcomes

  • Languages & Platforms : Python, Power Apps, Power Automate, Databricks, Snowflake
  • Enterprise Systems : SAP HANA, Kafka, UiPath
  • AI Platforms : Microsoft AI Foundry (highly preferred ), Copilot Studio (optional )
  • Cloud & ML Tools : Azure Machine Learning, Azure DevOps, GitHub
  • Data & Observability : Vector Databases, Azure Monitor
  • Vision & IoT : Azure IoT Hub, OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch (for edge and vision-based agents)

What You Bring

  • Proven experience leading AI engineering teams and delivering enterprise-grade solutions
  • Strong technical depth in AI/ML, cloud platforms, and agentic system design
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, drive clarity, and influence across functions
  • Passion for building transformative AI systems that solve meaningful problems

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)


About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  • Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes
  • Walk us through a feature or project you’ve built, focusing on code review, design decisions, improvements, and lessons learned. This is an opportunity to showcase your technical expertise and problem-solving approach.

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Minas Gerais
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Pleno
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;


Requisitos e qualificações

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;


Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.
  • Fazemos Code Review. Nenhuma mudança vai para a operação sem o time aprovar. Seja via thumbs up do Gitlab ou durante uma discussão da daily.
  • Todo desenvolvimento de uma nova fonte é baseado em especificações que são escritas pela nossa pessoa Data Owner. Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.



#NeoJourney l Cardápio de Benefícios:

Vale Alimentação/Refeição;

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
