Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Lead Engineer – Agentic AI
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Lead Engineer – Agentic AI , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

You’ll lead the architecture, development, and deployment of next-generation agentic AI systems that transform enterprise operations. These intelligent agents will autonomously orchestrate workflows, analyze real-time data, and embed decision-making across domains like finance, sales, and operations. You’ll guide cross-functional teams, mentor engineers, and ensure technical excellence across all stages of delivery. Microsoft AI Foundry will be a key platform for agent development, and Copilot Studio may be used optionally for few use cases.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and lead development of scalable, production-grade agentic AI systems.
  • Design serverless, event-driven workflows using Azure Functions , Logic Apps , and Power Automate .
  • Build and optimize ML models for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and recommendations using Azure ML , Databricks , and Python .
  • Integrate agents with enterprise platforms such as SAP HANA , Salesforce , Snowflake , Kafka , and UiPath .
  • Ensure observability and reliability through Azure Monitor , logging, and alerting frameworks.
  • Define and enforce architecture patterns, reusable components, and governance standards.
  • Lead code reviews, technical design sessions, and agile ceremonies.
  • Leverage Microsoft AI Foundry to build and deploy agents that meet enterprise-grade standards.


Leadership Responsibilities

  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
  • Drive cross-team collaboration and alignment on agentic AI strategy and execution.
  • Own delivery timelines, quality benchmarks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Champion best practices in DevOps, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management.
  • Stay ahead of trends in AI, machine vision, and IoT to guide strategic decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Data Scientists & ML Engineers – for model development and integration
  • Product Managers & UX Designers – aligning agent capabilities with user needs
  • Enterprise Architects & DevOps Engineers – ensuring scalability and deployment efficiency
  • Security & Compliance Teams – meeting regulatory and governance requirements
  • Business Stakeholders & SMEs – defining use cases and validating outcomes
  • Change Management & Enablement Teams – supporting adoption and training efforts

Technology & Tools

  • Languages & Platforms : Python, Power Apps, Power Automate, Databricks, Snowflake
  • Enterprise Systems : SAP HANA, Kafka, UiPath
  • AI Platforms : Microsoft AI Foundry (highly preferred ), Copilot Studio (optional )
  • Cloud & ML Tools : Azure Machine Learning, Azure DevOps, GitHub
  • Data & Observability : Vector Databases, Azure Monitor
  • Vision & IoT : Azure IoT Hub, OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch (for edge and vision-based agents)

What You Bring

  • Proven experience leading AI engineering teams and delivering enterprise-grade solutions
  • Strong technical depth in AI/ML, cloud platforms, and agentic system design
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, drive clarity, and influence across functions
  • Passion for building transformative AI systems that solve meaningful problems

title: Analista de Faturamento Jr
description:
A Unox , líder global na produção de fornos de alta qualidade e com presença cada vez mais sólida no Brasil, está procurando um Analista de Faturamento Jr para se juntar à nossa equipe.


Nessa função, você será responsável pelos processos de faturamento e no apoio ao setor comercial, realizando a gestão de pedidos de peças, fornos, detergentes e pedidos em garantia. A pessoa selecionada fará o processamento dos pedidos, garantindo agilidade e organização para entrega, além de manter comunicação com clientes e diferentes stakeholders da área.


Atividades:

  • Emitir e conferir notas fiscais, com gestão de toda implicação tributária/fiscal;
  • Acompanhar o andamento dos pedidos e garantir a comunicação eficaz com os clientes sobre prazos e atualizações.
  • Inserir e acompanhar pedidos (peças, equipamentos, detergentes) nos sistemas;
  • Organizar a separação dos itens junto à logística;
  • Atualizar planilhas de controle e documentação de pedidos;
  • Prestar atendimento aos clientes por e-mail e telefone;
  • Aplicar processos padrões de faturamento, devoluções e correções básicas em sistema.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Gestão Financeira ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento fiscal, tributário e na área de faturamento;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Conhecimento em Excel;
  • Facilidade com sistemas e ferramentas digitais;

Diferencial: Inglês intermediário.


Por que Unox?

Inovação contínua : A Unox está na vanguarda da tecnologia e inovação, oferecendo aos seus colaboradores a oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos pioneiros e desafiadores.

Ambiente de trabalho : Fomos certificados pelo Great Place To Work Institute como uma das 100 melhores empresas da Europa. Nosso ambiente de trabalho jovem e positivo promove a colaboração e valoriza as ideias de todos os nossos funcionários. Organizamos regularmente eventos da empresa para networking e formação de equipes com colegas.

Crescimento Profissional : A Unox investe no desenvolvimento de seus colaboradores por meio de programas de treinamento contínuo, coaching individual e oportunidades de carreira, garantindo constante crescimento pessoal e profissional.

O posto de trabalho está aberto a candidatos de todos os gêneros e identidades de gênero, em conformidade com os regulamentos atuais de igualdade de oportunidades.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)


About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  • Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes
  • Walk us through a feature or project you’ve built, focusing on code review, design decisions, improvements, and lessons learned. This is an opportunity to showcase your technical expertise and problem-solving approach.

  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Pleno
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;


Requisitos e qualificações

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;


Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.
  • Fazemos Code Review. Nenhuma mudança vai para a operação sem o time aprovar. Seja via thumbs up do Gitlab ou durante uma discussão da daily.
  • Todo desenvolvimento de uma nova fonte é baseado em especificações que são escritas pela nossa pessoa Data Owner. Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.

Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
company: TD Media LLC (dba Life Water Media)

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Lead Engineer – Agentic AI
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Lead Engineer – Agentic AI , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

You’ll lead the architecture, development, and deployment of next-generation agentic AI systems that transform enterprise operations. These intelligent agents will autonomously orchestrate workflows, analyze real-time data, and embed decision-making across domains like finance, sales, and operations. You’ll guide cross-functional teams, mentor engineers, and ensure technical excellence across all stages of delivery. Microsoft AI Foundry will be a key platform for agent development, and Copilot Studio may be used optionally for few use cases.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and lead development of scalable, production-grade agentic AI systems.
  • Design serverless, event-driven workflows using Azure Functions , Logic Apps , and Power Automate .
  • Build and optimize ML models for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and recommendations using Azure ML , Databricks , and Python .
  • Integrate agents with enterprise platforms such as SAP HANA , Salesforce , Snowflake , Kafka , and UiPath .
  • Ensure observability and reliability through Azure Monitor , logging, and alerting frameworks.
  • Define and enforce architecture patterns, reusable components, and governance standards.
  • Lead code reviews, technical design sessions, and agile ceremonies.
  • Leverage Microsoft AI Foundry to build and deploy agents that meet enterprise-grade standards.


Leadership Responsibilities

  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
  • Drive cross-team collaboration and alignment on agentic AI strategy and execution.
  • Own delivery timelines, quality benchmarks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Champion best practices in DevOps, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management.
  • Stay ahead of trends in AI, machine vision, and IoT to guide strategic decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Data Scientists & ML Engineers – for model development and integration
  • Product Managers & UX Designers – aligning agent capabilities with user needs
  • Enterprise Architects & DevOps Engineers – ensuring scalability and deployment efficiency
  • Security & Compliance Teams – meeting regulatory and governance requirements
  • Business Stakeholders & SMEs – defining use cases and validating outcomes
  • Change Management & Enablement Teams – supporting adoption and training efforts

Technology & Tools

  • Languages & Platforms : Python, Power Apps, Power Automate, Databricks, Snowflake
  • Enterprise Systems : SAP HANA, Kafka, UiPath
  • AI Platforms : Microsoft AI Foundry (highly preferred ), Copilot Studio (optional )
  • Cloud & ML Tools : Azure Machine Learning, Azure DevOps, GitHub
  • Data & Observability : Vector Databases, Azure Monitor
  • Vision & IoT : Azure IoT Hub, OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch (for edge and vision-based agents)

What You Bring

  • Proven experience leading AI engineering teams and delivering enterprise-grade solutions
  • Strong technical depth in AI/ML, cloud platforms, and agentic system design
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, drive clarity, and influence across functions
  • Passion for building transformative AI systems that solve meaningful problems

title: Gerente Executivo(a) Sustentabilidade e Meio Ambiente
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente Executivo(a) de Sustentabilidade e Meio Ambiente para integrar nosso time da Diretoria de Sustentabilidade, Novos Negócios e Relações Institucionais.


Quais as responsabilidades?

  • Liderar a estratégia e a gestão integrada de Sustentabilidade e Meio Ambiente da companhia, assegurando o cumprimento de requisitos legais e ambientais, a evolução da agenda ESG, a redução de riscos climáticos e ambientais, e a geração de valor sustentável para a empresa, seus stakeholders e a sociedade;
  • Liderar o plano de descarbonização da companhia, considerando o roadmap para atingimento de metas de redução de emissões alinhadas ao SBTi, incluindo análise de riscos físicos e de transição e identificação de soluções de baixo carbono;
  • Liderar a realização de inventários de emissões de GEE;
  • Coordenar os processos de certificações socioambientais (Bonsucro, Renovabio, SAI, CARB, EPA, SMETA, ISCC CORSIA, entre outros);
  • Coordenar a publicação do Relatório de Sustentabilidade, garantindo transparência e aderência a padrões internacionais;
  • Gerenciar, em coordenação com outras áreas da empresa, processos para o estabelecimento de uma cadeia de valor responsável e sustentável;
  • Assegurar a conformidade com requisitos legais, licenças e condicionantes ambientais;
  • Coordenar a implantação e evolução do Sistema de Gestão Ambiental, garantindo sua integração às operações agroindustriais, considerando gestão de resíduos, recursos hídricos, emissões atmosféricas, biodiversidade e outros potenciais impactos ambientais;
  • Implementar ações de reflorestamento e prevenção a incêndios;
  • Atuar na gestão de impactos, riscos e incidentes ambientais, incluindo identificação, controles operacionais, tratamento de incidentes e avaliações de abrangência;
  • Administrar a gestão de passivos ambientais;
  • Desenvolver, divulgar, avaliar e implantar, após previamente discutidas e analisadas, projetos e inovações técnicas em meio ambiente, objetivando minimizar os impactos no meio ambiente.


Quais os requisitos?

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia ou áreas afins;
  • Conhecimento em normas e legislação ambiental;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente;
  • Disponibilidade para residir em São José do Rio Preto/SP.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)


About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  • Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes
  • Walk us through a feature or project you’ve built, focusing on code review, design decisions, improvements, and lessons learned. This is an opportunity to showcase your technical expertise and problem-solving approach.

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Pleno
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;


Requisitos e qualificações

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;


Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.
  • Fazemos Code Review. Nenhuma mudança vai para a operação sem o time aprovar. Seja via thumbs up do Gitlab ou durante uma discussão da daily.
  • Todo desenvolvimento de uma nova fonte é baseado em especificações que são escritas pela nossa pessoa Data Owner. Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.

Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. We are looking for a Lead Engineer – Agentic AI , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

You’ll lead the architecture, development, and deployment of next-generation agentic AI systems that transform enterprise operations. These intelligent agents will autonomously orchestrate workflows, analyze real-time data, and embed decision-making across domains like finance, sales, and operations. You’ll guide cross-functional teams, mentor engineers, and ensure technical excellence across all stages of delivery. Microsoft AI Foundry will be a key platform for agent development, and Copilot Studio may be used optionally for few use cases.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and lead development of scalable, production-grade agentic AI systems.
  • Design serverless, event-driven workflows using Azure Functions , Logic Apps , and Power Automate .
  • Build and optimize ML models for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and recommendations using Azure ML , Databricks , and Python .
  • Integrate agents with enterprise platforms such as SAP HANA , Salesforce , Snowflake , Kafka , and UiPath .
  • Ensure observability and reliability through Azure Monitor , logging, and alerting frameworks.
  • Define and enforce architecture patterns, reusable components, and governance standards.
  • Lead code reviews, technical design sessions, and agile ceremonies.
  • Leverage Microsoft AI Foundry to build and deploy agents that meet enterprise-grade standards.


Leadership Responsibilities

  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
  • Drive cross-team collaboration and alignment on agentic AI strategy and execution.
  • Own delivery timelines, quality benchmarks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Champion best practices in DevOps, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management.
  • Stay ahead of trends in AI, machine vision, and IoT to guide strategic decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Data Scientists & ML Engineers – for model development and integration
  • Product Managers & UX Designers – aligning agent capabilities with user needs
  • Enterprise Architects & DevOps Engineers – ensuring scalability and deployment efficiency
  • Security & Compliance Teams – meeting regulatory and governance requirements
  • Business Stakeholders & SMEs – defining use cases and validating outcomes
  • Change Management & Enablement Teams – supporting adoption and training efforts

Technology & Tools

  • Languages & Platforms : Python, Power Apps, Power Automate, Databricks, Snowflake
  • Enterprise Systems : SAP HANA, Kafka, UiPath
  • AI Platforms : Microsoft AI Foundry (highly preferred ), Copilot Studio (optional )
  • Cloud & ML Tools : Azure Machine Learning, Azure DevOps, GitHub
  • Data & Observability : Vector Databases, Azure Monitor
  • Vision & IoT : Azure IoT Hub, OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch (for edge and vision-based agents)

What You Bring

  • Proven experience leading AI engineering teams and delivering enterprise-grade solutions
  • Strong technical depth in AI/ML, cloud platforms, and agentic system design
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, drive clarity, and influence across functions
  • Passion for building transformative AI systems that solve meaningful problems

title: Lead Engineer – Agentic AI
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Lead Engineer – Agentic AI , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

You’ll lead the architecture, development, and deployment of next-generation agentic AI systems that transform enterprise operations. These intelligent agents will autonomously orchestrate workflows, analyze real-time data, and embed decision-making across domains like finance, sales, and operations. You’ll guide cross-functional teams, mentor engineers, and ensure technical excellence across all stages of delivery. Microsoft AI Foundry will be a key platform for agent development, and Copilot Studio may be used optionally for few use cases.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and lead development of scalable, production-grade agentic AI systems.
  • Design serverless, event-driven workflows using Azure Functions , Logic Apps , and Power Automate .
  • Build and optimize ML models for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and recommendations using Azure ML , Databricks , and Python .
  • Integrate agents with enterprise platforms such as SAP HANA , Salesforce , Snowflake , Kafka , and UiPath .
  • Ensure observability and reliability through Azure Monitor , logging, and alerting frameworks.
  • Define and enforce architecture patterns, reusable components, and governance standards.
  • Lead code reviews, technical design sessions, and agile ceremonies.
  • Leverage Microsoft AI Foundry to build and deploy agents that meet enterprise-grade standards.


Leadership Responsibilities

  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
  • Drive cross-team collaboration and alignment on agentic AI strategy and execution.
  • Own delivery timelines, quality benchmarks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Champion best practices in DevOps, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management.
  • Stay ahead of trends in AI, machine vision, and IoT to guide strategic decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Data Scientists & ML Engineers – for model development and integration
  • Product Managers & UX Designers – aligning agent capabilities with user needs
  • Enterprise Architects & DevOps Engineers – ensuring scalability and deployment efficiency
  • Security & Compliance Teams – meeting regulatory and governance requirements
  • Business Stakeholders & SMEs – defining use cases and validating outcomes
  • Change Management & Enablement Teams – supporting adoption and training efforts

Technology & Tools

  • Languages & Platforms : Python, Power Apps, Power Automate, Databricks, Snowflake
  • Enterprise Systems : SAP HANA, Kafka, UiPath
  • AI Platforms : Microsoft AI Foundry (highly preferred ), Copilot Studio (optional )
  • Cloud & ML Tools : Azure Machine Learning, Azure DevOps, GitHub
  • Data & Observability : Vector Databases, Azure Monitor
  • Vision & IoT : Azure IoT Hub, OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch (for edge and vision-based agents)

What You Bring

  • Proven experience leading AI engineering teams and delivering enterprise-grade solutions
  • Strong technical depth in AI/ML, cloud platforms, and agentic system design
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, drive clarity, and influence across functions
  • Passion for building transformative AI systems that solve meaningful problems


<<<< Please attach resume in English>>>>>>


What do we offer? TCS Benefits in Brazil:

● Health insurance

● Dental Plan

● Life insurance

● Transportation vouchers

● Meal/Food Voucher

● Childcare assistance

● Gympass

● TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

● Partnership with SESC

● Reimbursement of Certifications

● Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

● International experience opportunity

● Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

● Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

● TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

● Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility to build a TCS that respects each person. Our motto is “Inclusion without exception”. Join us and become a TCSer!

#Buildingonbelief

title: Técnico de automação
description:
Sobre a vaga


A GESTAMP é uma multinacional espanhola dedicada ao design, desenvolvimento e fabricação de componentes metálicos automotivos. Trabalhamos para servir com excelência nossos clientes e sociedade, com veículos cada vez mais eficientes e seguros, e buscamos talentos que compartilhem da mesma visão e ambição.


Somos inclusivos ,aqui todas as pessoas são bem-vindas .


Técnico de Automação I - GESTAMP SÃO JOSÉ DOS PINHAIS / PR


Resumo das atividades:

Nesta oportunidade você atuará na manutenção preventiva, corretiva, preditiva e melhorias elétricas e automação industrial.


Principais responsabilidades:


Estamos em busca de um profissional com experiência em automação industrial, capaz de atuar com excelência nas seguintes atividades:

• Análise de Dados para Otimização de Sistemas Automatizados

Utilização de ferramentas de análise de dados para identificar oportunidades de melhoria, aumentar a eficiência e reduzir falhas em sistemas automatizados.

• Interface Homem-Máquina (IHM)

Realização de download, upload, configuração e programação de IHMs, garantindo a comunicação eficiente entre operadores e sistemas automatizados.

• Leitura e Interpretação de Desenhos Técnicos

• Conhecimentos em Eletricidade e Eletrônica Industrial

Atuação com sistemas de comando e potência, realizando diagnósticos, ajustes e melhorias em equipamentos e instalações industriais.


Qualificação e Requisitos:


Conhecimento em PLC e Leitura e interpretação de esquema elétrico

Vivência na área de automação, com foco em instalação, programação e manutenção de sistemas automatizados em ambientes industriais


Escolaridade:

Técnico completo em Eletroeletrônica, Automação, Mecatrônica e afins.


Horário:

Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos

-Wellhub e Total pass (academia e bem-estar)

- Plano odontológico

- Seguro de vida

- Convênio farmácia

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)


About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  • Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes
  • Walk us through a feature or project you’ve built, focusing on code review, design decisions, improvements, and lessons learned. This is an opportunity to showcase your technical expertise and problem-solving approach.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)


About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teams


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
  • Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
  • Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.



Essential Skills

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;
  • Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
  • Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch;
  • Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.

• Ensure JDE, Trintech, and other financial applications are compliant with Gallagher’s IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.

• Advanced level proficiency with Microsoft Office tools including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio

• Intermediate SQL query skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams

title: ANALISTA PREVENÇÃO RISCOS E FRAUDES PL
description:
Resumo da Vaga:

O Analista de Prevenção a Riscos e Fraudes Pleno será responsável por investigar denúncias e suspeitas de fraudes no Grupo Petrópolis, recebidas pelo Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais. O profissional atuará de maneira imparcial, ética e legal, visando identificar e esclarecer fatos, fraudes de colaboradores e terceiros. O foco é fornecer informações cruciais para a tomada de decisões dentro dos parâmetros legais, normas e procedimentos internos, além de apoiar o jurídico nas análises dos casos.



OBJETIVOS:

Avaliação de Denúncias e Demandas:

  • Analisar e avaliar denúncias de fraudes oriundas do Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais, identificando os procedimentos a serem adotados e contribuindo com informações para decisões internas.

Investigações Sistêmicas:

  • Realizar investigações utilizando sistemas internos, envolvendo públicos internos e externos, para detectar violações legais, políticas e procedimentos. Identificar oportunidades de ações corretivas nos processos da empresa contribuindo para melhoria contínua.

Investigações em Campo:

  • Conduzir investigações, com diligências e contato com testemunhas e envolvidos, coletando evidências (vídeos, fotos, depoimentos, relatórios) para subsidiar a investigação.

Elaboração de Relatórios:

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados com os resultados das investigações, identificando falhas ou não conformidades e informando as áreas pertinentes, como o departamento jurídico.
  • Atualização Constante:

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

  • Apoio à Gestão:

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.



DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência em Segurança Pública: Profissionais com histórico em segurança pública, como policiais, bombeiros ou agentes de segurança;
  • Cursos relacionados a investigação e prevenção de fraudes, técnicas de entrevista, conhecimento em Compliance e Canal de conduta;
  • Experiência nas Forças Armadas: Profissionais com experiência militar, incluindo ex-militares e reservistas.



REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas, Gestão em Segurança Empresarial, Investigações de fraudes, Compliance e áreas correlacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos básicos das atividades de Compliance;
  • Gestão de Riscos e Investigações;
  • Análise de Dados;
  • Conhecimento no sistema SAP;
  • Excel Intermediário/ Avançado e BI;
  • Experiência na área de prevenção à fraude;
  • Conhecimento de coleta de dados e informações de fontes públicas (OSINT);
  • Habilitação categoria B ativa;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


BENEFÍCIOS

  • Assistência médica e odontológica estendida a dependentes;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Vale refeição;
  • Auxílio material escolar (filhos);
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Wellhub;
  • Participação nos lucros;
  • Descontos em produtos;
  • Programas de saúde e bem-estar;
  • Carro da empresa como ferramenta de trabalho.

title: ANALISTA PREVENÇÃO RISCOS E FRAUDES PL
description:
Resumo da Vaga:

O Analista de Prevenção a Riscos e Fraudes Pleno será responsável por investigar denúncias e suspeitas de fraudes no Grupo Petrópolis, recebidas pelo Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais. O profissional atuará de maneira imparcial, ética e legal, visando identificar e esclarecer fatos, fraudes de colaboradores e terceiros. O foco é fornecer informações cruciais para a tomada de decisões dentro dos parâmetros legais, normas e procedimentos internos, além de apoiar o jurídico nas análises dos casos.



OBJETIVOS:

Avaliação de Denúncias e Demandas:

  • Analisar e avaliar denúncias de fraudes oriundas do Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais, identificando os procedimentos a serem adotados e contribuindo com informações para decisões internas.

Investigações Sistêmicas:

  • Realizar investigações utilizando sistemas internos, envolvendo públicos internos e externos, para detectar violações legais, políticas e procedimentos. Identificar oportunidades de ações corretivas nos processos da empresa contribuindo para melhoria contínua.

Investigações em Campo:

  • Conduzir investigações, com diligências e contato com testemunhas e envolvidos, coletando evidências (vídeos, fotos, depoimentos, relatórios) para subsidiar a investigação.

Elaboração de Relatórios:

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados com os resultados das investigações, identificando falhas ou não conformidades e informando as áreas pertinentes, como o departamento jurídico.
  • Atualização Constante:

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

  • Apoio à Gestão:

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.



DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência em Segurança Pública: Profissionais com histórico em segurança pública, como policiais, bombeiros ou agentes de segurança;
  • Cursos relacionados a investigação e prevenção de fraudes, técnicas de entrevista, conhecimento em Compliance e Canal de conduta;
  • Experiência nas Forças Armadas: Profissionais com experiência militar, incluindo ex-militares e reservistas.



REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas, Gestão em Segurança Empresarial, Investigações de fraudes, Compliance e áreas correlacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos básicos das atividades de Compliance;
  • Gestão de Riscos e Investigações;
  • Análise de Dados;
  • Conhecimento no sistema SAP;
  • Excel Intermediário/ Avançado e BI;
  • Experiência na área de prevenção à fraude;
  • Conhecimento de coleta de dados e informações de fontes públicas (OSINT);
  • Habilitação categoria B ativa;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


BENEFÍCIOS

  • Assistência médica e odontológica estendida a dependentes;

  • Vale alimentação;

  • Auxílio material escolar (filhos);
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Wellhub;
  • Participação nos lucros;
  • Descontos em produtos;
  • Programas de saúde e bem-estar;
  • Carro da empresa como ferramenta de trabalho.
